subject: leaf-eared mouse
title: A Mouse Was Caught by Hand on a Volcano 22,000 Feet Up

scenes.text: Nothing grows up here. A mouse was living here anyway.
It's the top of an Andes volcano, about twenty-two thousand feet high.
A biologist spotted a leaf-eared mouse on the summit rocks and grabbed it by hand.
No mammal had ever been found that high.
The air has half the oxygen of sea level, and it's almost always below freezing.
Its body burns fat for extra heat. So the highest mammal on Earth? A mouse.

description:
In 2020 a biologist caught a yellow-rumped leaf-eared mouse by hand on the summit of Llullaillaco, an Andean volcano about 22,000 feet (6,739 m) high, the highest any mammal has been found.
There is no vegetation, about half the oxygen of sea level and temperatures below freezing nearly all the time; highland mice produce more body heat using fat-burning tissue.
How does it find anything to eat up there?
first_comment: Even climbers only stay a few minutes on that summit. How high do you think you could survive?
